restoration_note: Teaching structures the redemption arc as four Faces of Light (First Man, Third Ambassador, Jesus the Radiance, Great Counsel) sent from the Greatness, mirrored by four Counterparts of Darkness (King of Darkness, evil counsel, desire, law of Sin and Death). The formulaic anatomy assigned to each Face — tree / stature / ship / soul — heavily constrains line-break completions and ordinal-introducers, which permit confident restoration. Editor proposals based on cross-line letter continuations (lines 4-6, 22, 24, 25, 27, 30, 33, 36-39, 49-50, 53, 56, 60-61, 67-68, 71-72, 74) accepted with high confidence as they are letter-traces or syntactic necessities. At {30}, I correct the editor's 'Sin' to 'Death' (ⲡⲙⲟⲩ) because the spiritual reading explicitly supplies '[death]' here, and the standard 'law of Sin and Death' formula is reserved for the fourth counterpart at {80}/section 285. {51}/{52} restored with moderate confidence as 'all the Darkness' fitting the trace ...ⲩ. Many lacunae in mid-text (single-line gaps between formulaic anchors at sections 226, 227, 230, 246-247, 249-250, 263, 273-279, 281-284) lack constraints — neither traces nor parallel formulas fix them, and the relevant body-anatomy slots (tree-of-this-Face, stature-of-this-Face) could be filled with multiple lexically valid options; these are honestly marked unrestorable. The 23-char heading lacuna at {79} likewise remains unrestorable as no parallel formula governs the transition into the fourth counterpart.
